english:
Losing Flux of Darkness or Field of Light grants <solar Cure /> x1 and <solar Restoration />.

Duration by tier: 2.5|3|3.5|3.5|? seconds. Restoration by tier: x1|x1|x1|x2|x2.

<solar Ember of Solace /> increases the duration by 50%.

source.text:
Upon losing Flux of Darkness or Field of Light:

Cure x1 and Restoration with a varying duration. 
Ember of Solace increases the duration by 50%.

2.5s | 3s | 3.5s | 3.5s | ?s Duration
